title: The modified Zuojin formula (SQQT) associates ILC2-linked JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc cascade and gastric metaplasia regression.
authors: Yang, Xuefei; Wang, Yuedan; Liu, Shan; Ji, Haijie; Zhang, Jiaqi; Lv, Lin; Lu, Mengxiong; Wang, Ping; Wang, Fengyun; Tang, Xudong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方SQQT通过ILC2/JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc通路改善胃化生，虽含分子对接但核心为药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The modified Zuojin formula (SQQT) has been clinically prescribed for gastric metaplasia (GM) for several decades in China. The therapeutic efficacy of SQQT and potential mechanisms have been demonstrated in our previous studies. This research will further investigate its mechanism in the immune microenvironment. AIM OF THE STUDY: We aimed to determine the influence of SQQT on the ILC2-mediated JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc pathway during GM. METHODS: The mechanism of GM in patients was measured through single-cell RNA sequencing. The constituents of SQQT have been examined before. The role of SQQT targets JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc pathway was verified by network pharmacology and molecular docking. The model of GM was induced by tamoxifen (5 mg/20 g), CD90.2 protein (200 mug) or SQQT (1.69, 3.38, 6.76 g/kg) was given to treat GM mice. The SQQT mechanism was confirmed by both in vitro and in vivo studies. Histological analysis, serum cytokines, and protein levels were assessed. RESULTS: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis indicated that ILC2 increased in the GM patients, the goblet cells in GM were probably transferred from endocrine cells. Compounds in SQQT are related to cell proliferation and can bind to the JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc pathway proteins. The main components of SQQT, can spontaneously bind to the JAK-2 protein in 9 sites. Tamoxifen caused body weight decrease, spleen weight increase, stomach injury, ILC2 increase, and cytokines increase in the GM group. After examining the cytokines, IL-5 was the only one significantly increased in the GM group. CD90.2 and SQQT can alleviate histological changes of the stomach corpus, inflammation cytokines, and other GM-related indicators. Moreover, cell proliferation and JAK-2 pathway markers were depressed in GM mice. Besides, SQQT protects GES-1 cells from IL-5 injury related to upregulating JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc proteins in 24h, 48h and 72h. CONCLUSION: The mechanism of SQQT protected the stomach from metaplasia associated to ILC2 activation and the subsequent cell proliferation through IL-5/JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：改良左金方（SQQT）在中国已被临床用于治疗胃化生（GM）数十年。我们前期研究已证实SQQT的治疗效果及潜在机制。本研究将进一步探讨其在免疫微环境中的作用机制。研究目的：我们旨在确定SQQT在GM期间对ILC2介导的JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc通路的影响。方法：通过单细胞RNA测序检测患者GM的机制。SQQT的组成成分已在先前研究中检测。通过网络药理学和分子对接验证SQQT靶向JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc通路的作用。GM模型由他莫昔芬（5 mg/20 g）诱导，给予CD90.2蛋白（200 μg）或SQQT（1.69、3.38、6.76 g/kg）治疗GM小鼠。通过体外和体内研究确认SQQT机制。评估组织学分析、血清细胞因子和蛋白水平。结果：单细胞RNA测序分析表明，GM患者中ILC2增加，GM中的杯状细胞可能由内分泌细胞转化而来。SQQT中的化合物与细胞增殖相关，并能结合JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc通路蛋白。SQQT的主要成分可自发结合JAK-2蛋白的9个位点。他莫昔芬导致GM组体重下降、脾重增加、胃损伤、ILC2增加和细胞因子增加。检测细胞因子后，IL-5是GM组中唯一显著增加的因子。CD90.2和SQQT可缓解胃体组织学变化、炎症细胞因子及其他GM相关指标。此外，GM小鼠中细胞增殖和JAK-2通路标志物受到抑制。另外，SQQT在24小时、48小时和72小时通过上调JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc蛋白保护GES-1细胞免受IL-5损伤。结论：SQQT通过IL-5/JAK-2/STAT5/c-Myc通路保护胃免受与ILC2激活及后续细胞增殖相关的化生。
